mandatory.physical_identity: Stable ID and named physically distinct site; deduplicate against current canonical IDs and existing OSM features, including internal chapel/precinct distinctions.
mandatory.catholic_scope: Affiliation must be supported by accountable Catholic custodian, diocese, or other primary institutional source; existing Orthodox, Anglican, secular heritage should not be labelled active Catholic.
mandatory.category: Use most accurate present physical Place type without claiming unsupported formal sanctuary or monastic legal status.
mandatory.location: Country, meaningful locality, source-backed coordinates with precision and feature provenance; map anchor is not an entrance.
mandatory.provenance: At least one accountable identity record with URL retained internally; one independently attributed map feature stored in Place.geo. A second source-registry record duplicating OSM geo URL is optional.
mandatory.integrity: Stable frozen existing IDs, source references and country scopes; preserve source ambiguity holds; avoid unsupported category cross-links.

deferred_not_publication_gates: Separate typed map-source record when Place.geo already preserves OSM URL/ref
Detailed biography, timeline, bilingual introduction and long place guide
Feast/pilgrimage schedules, opening hours and visitor entrance
Specific chapel/relic/apparition/custody story not needed for physical site identity
Directory–Place matching, current TLM times, missal/rite, priest ministry or any Mass data
Customs, Saints, Calendar, archaeological and historic-route cross-domain links
source_display: Identity URL and OSM provenance are internal audit fields. No external link needs to appear in the initial user-facing place card.
excluded: Auto creating ordinary parish churches merely because they exist
Publishing an unlocated shrine title, name-only match or whole-country dedication
Treating an incomplete country census as comprehensive
next_step: Release independently verified minimal Catholic physical sites first, then run separate enrichment pipelines without holding up the world map.
